description: Local-first AI app Kit for a browser voice conversation loop with speech recognition, local chat, and speech output.
whatItDoes: Streams microphone audio from the browser to a CapaKit workload.
Transcribes speech with a local Whisper model.
Generates assistant replies through a bundled local llama.cpp dependency.
Speaks replies with a local Kokoro TTS model.
technologies: Bundled llama.cpp AI app Kit dependency
